statements.impact_statement: GO-2026-5932 covers golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, deprecated and unmaintained, with no fixed version (it now ships as its own module at v0.1.0-deprecated). In telegraf the only importer is github.com/google/go-github/v32/github (v32.1.0), pulled in by the github input plugin (plugins/inputs/github/github.go). go-github uses openpgp only in createSignature (github/git_commits.go:154-166), which Git.CreateCommit calls when a commit carries a SigningKey. The plugin calls only Repositories.Get (plugins/inputs/github/github.go:79), so no openpgp code runs. The recipe fails the build if any other package imports openpgp (go list -deps over ./cmd/telegraf) or if telegraf's source calls CreateCommit. Checked 2026-11-11 against telegraf 1.40.3.
